SymbolicEssence.ArchetypalFunction: To embody the encircling world ocean, source of all fresh waters, and the boundary between mortal and immortal realms.
SymbolicEssence.SymbolicCore: The endless stream that encircles and sustains all existence.

MythicAppearances: Father of 3000 river gods and Oceanids
CulturalContext.ReligiousOrRitualUse: Invoked in oaths and as witness to primordial events; did not participate in Titanomachy against Zeus.
CulturalContext.HistoricalEvolution: Pre-Greek water deity concept merged with Titan mythology; gradually superseded by Poseidon for maritime worship.

SymbolicRepresentation.ImageryNotes: Depicted as bearded elder with bull horns, fish tail, or as serpentine river encircling the world; often with crab claws.
SymbolicRepresentation.PoeticInvocation: Eldest river, eternal ring around the world, father of all flowing waters.
SymbolicRepresentation.DreamForm: An infinite river that flows in a circle, containing all other waters within its course

MetaIntegration.RitualFunction: Invoked for blessings of fresh water, peace, and as witness to sacred oaths.
AIPromptSeeds: The ancient river that remembers the first dawn.
The peaceful elder who chose not to fight, encompassing all conflict.
NarrativeHooks: The neutral party who refuses to take sides
The source from which all rivers flow
